name: Aspen Highlands
about: Real on-mountain facilities, researched for the 3D scenes. Lifts are keyed by OSM way id (same as data/highlands.json). Coordinates are local metres (x east, z south) from the same origin. 'verified': false marks anything not confirmed by a lift database, the resort or a photo; colours are read from dated photos and are approximate hex.
notes: Five Trees and the unnamed rope tow fall inside both the Highlands and Buttermilk boxes.

17117676.name: Cloud Nine
17117676.note: Newest and shortest detachable at Highlands.

151179408.name: Deep Temerity
151179408.note: Out of the bottom of Highland Bowl; LPA Alpha drive, Poma Z return.

17118210.name: Exhibition
17118210.note: Base lift from Highlands Village; replaced two doubles in series.

1212154522.name: Five Trees
1212154522.note: Private lift for the Five Trees homes between Highlands and Buttermilk; not open to the public.

1211521065.name: Lift
1211521065.note: Unnamed rope tow in OSM between Highlands and Buttermilk; appears in both resorts' data. Not identified.

17117678.name: Loge Peak
17117678.note: To the top of the lift-served mountain and the Highland Bowl hike; replaced a Riblet double.

buildings.name: Merry-Go-Round
buildings.style: Long, low single-storey mid-mountain restaurant (49 x 34 m, 435 seats) with a broad shallow-pitched roof, glass frontage and a big south-facing deck; the hub where the main lifts meet.

buildings.name: Cloud Nine Alpine Bistro
buildings.style: Small wooden chalet (20 x 16 m), a former patrol hut, with a red roof and a packed deck facing the Maroon Bells.

buildings.name: Highlands Village
buildings.style: Base village of four-to-five-storey red-brown timber and stone lodges around the Exhibition bottom.

signature.name: Highland Bowl ridge
signature.description: The hike-to bowl above Loge Peak: a narrow, treeless ridge with a bootpack and prayer flags to Highland Peak (12,392 ft); patrol memorial near the Loge Peak top. Mostly east-facing, up to 48 degrees.
signature.kit_note: The ridge is outside the baked lifts/runs; needs a bootpack line, prayer flags and the summit. Position not in our data.

signature.name: Cloud Nine
signature.description: Tiny red-roofed bistro hut with a famously crowded deck.

signature.name: Teal tower bases
signature.description: Highlands towers stand on teal-green painted bases.
